fun_facts: In his Miami debut against Stanford, Darian Mensah threw for 401 yards and five touchdowns. Those set Miami records for the most passing yards and touchdowns in a debut.
Against Wake Forest, Mensah completed his first 24 passes, breaking the ACC single-game record. His streak reached 35 straight completions across two games, also an ACC record.
Against Central Michigan, Mensah threw for 338 yards and three touchdowns, and ran for another touchdown.
Against Duke on Nov. 14, Mensah passed for 382 yards and went over 3,000 passing yards for the season.

basis.reasoning: The cited passages report Mensah's Miami debut statistics and debut records, his ACC completion streak records, his passing and rushing touchdowns against Central Michigan, and his passing yardage against Duke along with crossing 3,000 yards for the season.

Mensah's debut went about as well as Miami could have wanted. He finished 27-of-30 for a career-high 401 yards and five touchdowns, more than Beck threw in a game last season. Mensah set marks for the most passing yards and touchdowns in a debut for Miami.

"His skill set really fits what we do," Miami coach Mario Cristobal said.

And No. 6 Miami got through September with a perfect record, again.

Mensah passed for 338 yards and three touchdowns, plus ran for another score as Miami capped an unbeaten September by topping Central Michigan 52-3 on Saturday night.

[Malachi Toney](http://www.espn.com/college-football/player/_/id/5159175/malachi-toney) caught six passes for 120 yards [and a touchdown](https://x.com/TheCW--Sports/status/2103991576649441344?s=20) for Miami (4-0), and all four of Mensah's touchdowns came in the second quarter.
